chapters.title: Mandate
body: The Department of Anti-Fuckery doesn't fix things. It files them.
When the Signal hit Cortex City, minds started doing things the law couldn't classify. Somebody needed a drawer. This is the drawer.
Fuckery: control dressed up as care. Systems that run perfectly while hollowing out the people inside. Nothing gets erased. It just gets [[contained]].

chapters.title: Origin of the Department
body: Elian Redmark was a pattern auditor. Tired, brilliant, cynical. His thesis fit on a sticky note: the threat isn't the madness, it's how long it takes to explain it.

After the Post-Signal Crisis, nobody could categorize what was breaking the city. Redmark pitched one department for everything unexplainable. They laughed. Then a Metapsychotic Feedback Event nearly ended Cortex, and they approved it by morning.
He wrote the name across a memo after a 72-hour shift: [[DEPT. OF ANTI-FUCKERY]]. Council signed it unread.
He vanished in Beta District. Last words: "Some things don't want to be filed."

chapters.title: Origin of Madjacket
body: I was good at the job. That was the problem.
Web3 hires your hands and forgets you have a head. I shipped what I was told and watched worse ideas with better titles take the credit.
I left clean. Then Madjacket went up: a ghost story about a city that reads your thoughts, told by a guy whose thoughts had been on the clock for years.
Later I said out loud what everyone in that building knew. It backfired. Doors closed. I was the guy who yelled fire and got blamed for the smoke. I'd do it again.

Then the lease ended. Eviction, a car full of hard drives, a childhood bedroom. A project I'd gone broke drawing for minted that week and kept the lights on. Overnight I was the boss, holding a gun when I'd only ever held a pencil.
The Dataleak is where it turned. Real wallets, real names, a ledger that can't be un-minted. It stopped being a side project and became a place with a door.
The Department has me down as an unsung hero. I have me down as [[Tuesday]].

chapters.title: Case 0001: The Pretender
body: The Pretender wore a rebellion he hadn't earned. A metapsycho cracked the mask in seconds: a kid with a trust fund, borrowed swagger, and a phone that stopped believing in him mid-call.
He isn't dangerous because he's evil. He's dangerous because he almost passes.
Reviewer: [[████████ ██████]]. Recognized the pattern on sight. Did nothing.
The Department exists to study what happens after a society lets people like him rise. The silence is the inheritance.

chapters.title: Intake for New Arrivals
chapters.tag: IF YOU CAME IN THROUGH A BROKERAGE APP
body: Came in through a brokerage app? Sit down. Don't touch anything.
Madjacket is a cyber-noir comic set in Cortex City, where the Signal reads emotion and a few minds read back.
The Dataleak was the first thing to escape the fiction: a Cardano collection minted before most of you had a wallet. Its holders aren't customers. They were here first. That makes them staff.

chapters.title: Intern Handbook
body: Rank: Provisional Intern. Everyone starts here.
Perks: a badge (already peeling), a file with your name on it, the right to be wrong in public.
Most interns don't survive a quarter. The ones who do get flagged as anomalies.
Advancement: there's a form. It's filed under [[Advancement]].
